title: Gluten-Free American Beef Sandwich
description: A classic American-style beef sandwich made with gluten-free ingredients, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Form the ground beef into 4 patties.
Season the patties with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the patties for 4-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, toast the gluten-free hamburger buns on the grill.
Assemble the sandwiches by spreading ketchup on the bottom bun, followed by a beef patty, a slice of cheese, a few slices of pickle, and finally the top bun.
Top with lettuce leaves and serve immediately.
